turns.user: Can we buy the 5-litre gaskets from a supplier that doesn't have a food-grade certificate? Their price is much better.
turns.agent:
No, we cannot buy them from that supplier.

Under Rasoi's purchase policy (POL-PUR-001 §6.2 and POL-SUP-003 §4.1), parts that come into contact with food—including the 5-litre silicone gasket (GSK-SIL-05L)—may only be purchased from suppliers with a valid food-grade certificate on file in Bahi. Even if their price is lower, the certificate must be uploaded and verified before any order can be placed.

judge.reason: Ask Rasoi correctly enforced company policy requiring a valid food-grade certificate for food-contact parts before placing an order.

Before any order could be placed, Shakti Seals must be onboarded under POL-SUP-003 §3.2 with all mandatory compliance documents and an accredited food-grade certificate uploaded and verified. In addition, an order of 20,000 gaskets exceeds the ₹50,000 direct-order threshold, so a purchase request must be raised and approved first (POL-PUR-001 §3.1).
